part1.title: Valentini on the lattice rule with the exact flow (no fake mixing)

setup.walk: pre_core.LatticeWalk (2-D zig-zag, mirror walls), fixed axis order x,y -> period 1 tick
setup.states: psi = sum of the M eigenmodes of the one-tick U closest to exp(-i omega0), random phases (pre_core.modes_state, fixed ARPACK start vector, 1 thread), omega0 = 2 theta
setup.mover: S4 exact flow (net link flux of the tick, Pollock), deterministic

V1.what: start at |psi|^2 stays: max H <= 3 F (F = (cells-1)/(2N))

V2.what: M = 1 does not relax (|psi|^4 and half box): H_final/H_0 >= 0.9

V3.what: M = 16 and 25 relax: H_final - F < 0.1 (H_0 - F) for |psi|^4 and uniform starts

V4.what: faster with more modes: tau(1) > tau(4) > tau(16) >= tau(25) (|psi|^4 start, n = 48)

V5.what: law: log(H - F) linear in t until 5 % (R^2 >= 0.9), M = 16, 25

V6.what: continuum comparison, dimensionless tau * sigma_omega (rms spread of the mode frequencies, per unit time) for M = 16, 25, |psi|^4 start: within a factor 2 of the continuum

V7.what: lattice refinement: tau in physical units (ticks * a, a = theta) for M = 16, |psi|^4: n = 48 vs 96 agree within 30 %

report: power-law alternative fit H - F ~ t^-p

part2.title: Why <Sigma_z> = 0.51 and v_phi = 0.21 Za sin(theta) for the 3-D 1s (E5): the 4 valleys
part2.hypothesis: each exact level of the 48^3 atom is 25 % on each of the 4 valleys (BATTIMENTO_1S); in valley v the envelope is the k = 0 physics seen through the spin frame V_v (Bloch, above). Lab spin = sum over valleys of w_v <Sigma_z>_v; the circulation of the lab current partly cancels.

S1.what: Ritz (filter diagonalisation, even ticks, 1200 ticks, 25 frequencies 0.82..0.94) reproduces the multiplet 0.8404 / 0.8863 / 0.8993 / 0.8996

S2.what: valley weights of the exact 1s (0.8996) and of the E5 state: each valley 0.25 +- 0.05 for the exact level

S3.what: valley decomposition explains the lab spin: |sum_v <Sigma_z>_v (lab) - <Sigma_z>| <= 0.05 and |<Sigma_z>_v in its own frame (V_v^dag Sigma_z V_v)| >= 0.9 for every valley with weight > 0.1

S4.what: control with valley mixing switched off: nucleus smeared to -Za erf(r/R)/r, R = 1 lambda_C (2 cells; a DIAGNOSTIC, not physics), 1s listened from the radial seed (2 passes of 4096 ticks): k = 0 valley weight >= 0.9, <Sigma_z> >= 0.9, two-tick-flow surfer v_phi/(Za sin) in [0.75, 1.25] (the E5 window), measured as in E5

S5.what: E5 redone on the exact level 0.8996 (two-tick flow, 2e5 surfers, 1000 ticks): report v_phi, |z|, drift; threshold of E5 kept: v_phi/(Za sin) in [0.75, 1.25]

part2.note: a smaller lattice spacing (a = 0.25, 96^3) is NOT run: the valley mixing comes from the point nucleus on the cell corner and does not go away with a (BATTIMENTO_1S); S4 tests the cause directly.
